<svg viewBox="0 0 390 844" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="19" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">9:41</text>
    <line x1="326" y1="14" x2="326" y2="18" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="331" y1="12" x2="331" y2="18" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="336" y1="10" x2="336" y2="18" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="352" cy="15" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="352" y1="11" x2="352" y2="8" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="365" y="9" width="19" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <rect x="367" y="11" width="13" height="7" rx="1" fill="#00C6AE"/>
    <rect x="384" y="12" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#18191F"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Title bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="78" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="27" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">My tasks</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="320" y="48" width="46" height="46" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="334" y1="62" x2="352" y2="80" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2.5"/>
      <line x1="352" y1="62" x2="334" y2="80" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    </g>
    <line x1="24" y1="111" x2="366" y2="111" stroke="#EEEFF4" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Section heading -->
  <g>
    <text x="32" y="145" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="15" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">Today</text>
    <rect x="307" y="128" width="59" height="25" rx="13" fill="#D6FCF7"/>
    <text x="336" y="145" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">1 of 2</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Task one shadow and card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="32" y="166" width="326" height="88" rx="16" fill="#18191F" opacity="0.14"/>
    <rect x="32" y="164" width="326" height="88" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="52" y="190" width="28" height="28" rx="7" fill="#00C6AE" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="59,204 64,209 74,197" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <text x="96" y="199" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#969BAB" text-decoration="line-through">Send project update</text>
    <text x="96" y="222" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#969BAB">To Maya Chen · completed 9:12 AM</text>
    <circle cx="330" cy="206" r="3" fill="#969BAB"/>
    <circle cx="340" cy="206" r="3" fill="#969BAB"/>
    <circle cx="350" cy="206" r="3" fill="#969BAB"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Task two shadow and card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="32" y="270" width="326" height="88" rx="16" fill="#18191F" opacity="0.14"/>
    <rect x="32" y="268" width="326" height="88" rx="16" fill="#FFF4CC" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="52" y="294" width="28" height="28" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="96" y="303" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">Book dentist appointment</text>
    <text x="96" y="326" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#474A57">Due today · personal</text>
    <circle cx="330" cy="310" r="3" fill="#18191F"/>
    <circle cx="340" cy="310" r="3" fill="#18191F"/>
    <circle cx="350" cy="310" r="3" fill="#18191F"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Add task row -->
  <g>
    <rect x="32" y="382" width="326" height="64" rx="16" fill="#18191F" opacity="0.12"/>
    <rect x="32" y="380" width="326" height="64" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="64" cy="412" r="17" fill="#1947E5"/>
    <line x1="56" y1="412" x2="72" y2="412" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <line x1="64" y1="404" x2="64" y2="420" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <text x="94" y="418" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">Add a task</text>
    <polyline points="329,406 335,412 329,418" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Progress summary -->
  <g>
    <text x="32" y="493" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="15" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">Your progress</text>
    <rect x="32" y="512" width="326" height="104" rx="16" fill="#1947E5" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="56" y="545" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Daily completion</text>
    <text x="56" y="579" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="27" font-weight="800" fill="#FFFFFF">50%</text>
    <text x="304" y="545" text-anchor="end" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Monday, Jul 27</text>
    <rect x="160" y="568" width="166" height="10" rx="5" fill="#8094FF"/>
    <rect x="160" y="568" width="83" height="10" rx="5" fill="#00C6AE"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Small encouragement card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="32" y="644" width="326" height="58" rx="16" fill="#D6FCF7" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="60" cy="673" r="15" fill="#00C6AE"/>
    <polyline points="53,673 58,678 67,667" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="86" y="670" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="13" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">Nice work!</text>
    <text x="86" y="689" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#474A57">One more task to go today.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="754" width="390" height="90" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="754" x2="390" y2="754" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    
    <g>
      <polygon points="48,783 60,773 72,783 72,796 64,796 64,787 56,787 56,796 48,796" fill="none" stroke="#969BAB" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="60" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#969BAB">Home</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="129" y="773" width="23" height="25" rx="4" fill="#1947E5" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polyline points="134,785 139,790 148,780" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="140" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="11" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">Tasks</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="207" y="776" width="27" height="20" rx="6" fill="none" stroke="#969BAB" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polygon points="214,796 218,796 214,801" fill="#969BAB"/>
      <circle cx="216" cy="786" r="1.5" fill="#969BAB"/>
      <circle cx="222" cy="786" r="1.5" fill="#969BAB"/>
      <circle cx="228" cy="786" r="1.5" fill="#969BAB"/>
      <text x="220" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#969BAB">Inbox</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="308" cy="783" r="12" fill="none" stroke="#969BAB" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="308" cy="778" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#969BAB" stroke-width="2"/>
      <ellipse cx="308" cy="790" rx="7" ry="4" fill="none" stroke="#969BAB" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="308" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#969BAB">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
